name: Thai doors and windows
summary: Door and window types in common Thai sizes: timber and PVC swing doors, aluminium sliding doors and sliding, casement, awning and fixed windows.
description: 21 types named in Thai, marked D1-D4 and W1-W5: timber doors 700-900×2000 on a 2×4 frame, a PVC bathroom door, double doors 1200 and 1600, aluminium sliding doors 1600-2400, and aluminium windows with 5 mm glass, heads at 2100. Sizes are the usual Thai ones; adjust frames and materials to your supplier.
